jobs.occupation: International Clinician Scientist (f/d/m) for iPRACTIS (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Die Medizinische Hochschule Hannover (MHH), mit rund 10.000 Beschäftigten größter Landesbetrieb des Landes Niedersachsen, ist eine universitäre Einrichtung für Forschung und Lehre in der Human- und Zahnmedizin und ein Universitätsklinikum der Supramaximalversorgung. Forschung, Lehre, Krankenversorgung und Administration arbeiten im Integrationsmodell auf dem MHH-Campus Hand in Hand.
About us

Hannover Medical School (MHH) is offering positions in the international clinician scientist program (iPRACTIS), a unique opportunity for internationally mobile researchers with a completed medical degree outside of Germany. Over three years, you will gain experience in translational research while working towards medical degree recognition in Germany.

iPRACTIS supports internationally trained researchers aiming to build careers in academic medicine. Over three years, participants will deepen their research experience on a translational research project while working towards integration into the German academic and healthcare system.

We offer

The international clinician scientist program iPRACTIS offers:

- 36 months of structured clinical and scientific training based on an individually tailored career plan
- Individualized support in navigating the process of medical degree recognition in Germany and developing German language proficiency
- Funding for materials, travel, and publication
- Individualized support from a personalized mentoring team
- A curriculum to acquire key competencies [including data management and analysis, GCP clinical investigator certification (GCP-Prüfarztkurs), project management]
- Regular evaluations and feedback meetings
- A full onboarding program and integration into a strong Clinician Scientist Network

Clinical expectations: Participants will achieve recognition of their medical qualifications along with sufficient German language skills for clinical practice, allowing future specialist training and medical practice in Germany.

Research expectations: Participants will develop as a R2 researcher (according to the European Framework for Research Careers), including submitting their first third-party funding application. Participants who complete this process will be ready to pursue an independent research career (R3) in roles such as assistant professor, principal investigator, or junior group leader.

Eligibility requirements

To apply, candidates must:

- Hold a completed medical degree (from outside Germany)
- Have initial research experience (completed R1 to early R2 based on European Framework for Research Careers)
- Have not yet completed specialist clinical training (residency or German 'Facharzt' / 'Weiterbildung' equivalent)
- Be committed to pursuing a career combining clinical practice and research

In order to consider your application, we require that you submit the completed "iPRACTIS Application Template" (download) as well as a cover letter and detailed resume (in table format), a declaration of consent and copies of certificates (medical examination certificates, doctoral degree certificates, high school diplomas, and other relevant certificates and documents. If the documents are not in German or English, a certified translation is requested). Please submit your application as a single PDF file directly to practis@mh-hannover.de. More information can be found at iPRACTIS.

External applications for iPRACTIS positions will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The deadline for internal applications is 05.01.2027.
For questions, please reach out to Dr. Thorsten Saenger: practis@mh-hannover.de.

jobs.occupation: Process & Performance Manager - Technical Integration & SAP S/4HANA (d/f/m) (Prozessmanager/in - RPA)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

We are currently looking for a **Process & Performance Manager – Technical Integration & SAP S/4HANA (d/f/m) ** to join our Solutions department at Satair in Hamburg.

We are a multinational team driving process management, operational stability, and technical integration within Satair's Solutions department.

Are you ready to shape the future of global aviation material management? Through our Material Management Industrialisation Platform (MMIP), Satair is transforming aviation supply chains into an integrated, high-performance ecosystem. In this role, you will act as the primary technical advocate and process champion for the Solutions department, bridging operational process modeling with our strategic greenfield transition to SAP S/4HANA.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU **

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees. Local benefits may vary.

- Competitive Remuneration
- Work / Life Balance: Hybrid Working, flex-time, maternity/paternity leave, job sharing
- Personal Development: Personalized development plans, large portfolio of learning solutions & lots of internal mobility opportunities
- Health & Wellbeing: Health insurance, well-being programs

Your Role Highlights:

- You will drive a high-impact transformation: Lead key project streams and shape our future SAP S/4HANA target architecture
- You will enjoy empowered ownership: Benefit from full freedom to challenge current processes and advise global leadership
- You will accelerate your professional growth: Access state-of-the-art Airbus/Satair learning frameworks and structured progression plans
- You will thrive in an international environment: Collaborate with diverse talent across Europe, APAC, and the Americas in a values-driven culture

**HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM **

- You will represent the Solutions department as the primary Process Champion in MMIP transformation boards
- You will translate complex IT and SAP architectures into actionable business risk, opportunity, and value statements
- You will evaluate system changes to safeguard active SLAs, operational stability, and technical roadmaps during greenfield streams (New Parts Flow, Customer Order Handling)
- You will map and optimize E2E workflows ("Happy Path") in SYMBIO to drive global standardization and ensure audit readiness
- You will define and track process KPI frameworks, error rates, and system dependencies to flag bottlenecks early
- You will facilitate seamless communication between operational teams and MMIP governance bodies, preparing decision matrices for leadership
- You will guide global delivery teams through change management from manual data entry to automated data oversight

**ABOUT YOU **

- You hold a degree in Business, Process Management, IT, or Engineering, combined with experience in global matrix organizations
- You bring a strong background in SAP transformations (S/4HANA, RISE, Fit-to-Standard) and core modules (MM/SD)
- You master process modeling tools (SYMBIO or ARIS) and agile methodologies (Scrum/SAFe, Jira, Confluence)
- You understand customer service operations, SLA management, and data-driven process KPIs
- You excel at translating technical jargon into business statements and influencing cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority
- You demonstrate diplomatic presence, resilience, and genuine empathy for operational realities across international cultures
- You are fluent in English

Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation. With our global functional organisation spanning 11 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 1,900 people supporting a $3.3 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family! If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our websitewww.SATAIR.com (http://www.satair.com/) or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel atwww.youtube.com/sataircompany (http://www.youtube.com/sataircompany) !

We are looking for a Principal Business Development Manager CMTS Cell Line Development (x|f|m) to join our Emerging Business Unit CMTS home based in Europe at Sartorius Sartorius Stedim Biotech GmbH. In this role, you will be responsible for winning high value, strategically critical opportunities through consultative workflow design, regulatory and process influence, and innovation – driven differentiation, significantly shaping market direction and advancing portfolio growth in close collaboration with Central Sales.

You will be joining a newly created team, and we are looking forward to shaping the future with you. This position is available for full-time. It is a field-based role requiring (>50%) traveling to customers worldwide, with an initial focus on the EMEA region.

Grow With Us – Your Responsibilities

- Identify, pursue and win high‑value, complex strategic opportunities across key markets and accounts by uncovering unmet needs, latent demand, and innovation‑driven use cases 
- Design end‑to‑end workflows and advanced technical concepts that directly influence customer decision pathways, operational processes, and regulatory considerations
- Lead competitive differentiation and high‑stakes deal shaping by synthesizing deep technical, application, and market insights to construct compelling value‑creation narratives that maximize our win rate 
- Guide commercial strategy with Central Sales by defining technical and functional requirements that determine solution configuration, pricing logic, and deal construct for strategic opportunities 
- Shape the market and the portfolio by identifying trends, innovation points, and customer‑driven signals that influence product strategy, roadmap decisions, and market positioning 
- Drive early adoption and lighthouse success by embedding solutions into critical workflows, resolving escalated technical barriers, and enabling a seamless handover to Central Sales for scaling 
- Provide technical input to Central Sales, Business Unit stakeholders (e.g. PM, other BU Tech Sales roles) and Legal on the technical sections of contract terms and conditions to ensure technical feasibility, clear scope definition, reduced delivery risk, and alignment with customer workflows, without assuming commercial ownership

What Will Convince Us

- A Master’s degree in Life Sciences (e.g., Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Immunology, Genetics, Chemistry, Virology) forms the academic foundation for this role; a PhD is a plus
- Extensive professional years of experience in senior technical sales, workflow consulting, application support, or presales within a scientific or technical environment are essential
- Experience of new business development, growing and maintaining customers, develop and monitor sales pipeline
- A demonstrated hunter mindset with a strong track record of identifying, advancing, and winning new opportunities is expected
- Hands‑on technical expertise — including demos, trials, and customer evaluations — is a core part of the position
- Strong consultative communication skills enable clear articulation of both technical and commercial value to diverse stakeholders
- Proficiency in CRM systems and structured sales processes, combined with disciplined documentation practices is required
- Willingness to travel more than 50%, with a strong focus on external customer engagements, is integral to the role
- Business-fluent English is mandatory; German proficiency is an advantage

What We Offer

As a growing global life science company, stock listed on the MDAX and TecDAX, Sartorius offers a wide range of Benefits

- Personal and Professional Development: Mentoring, leadership programs, Talent Talks, internal seminar offerings , coaching for managers
- Work Life Balance: Remote options, flextime, flexible work schedules, sabbaticals, Workation
- Making An Impact Right From The Start: Comprehensive onboarding, including a virtual online platform even before joining, Welcome Workshops, "buddy" as point of contact
- Travel Benefits: Company car (ex. service, sales), car leasing, bike leasing, large free parking garage, good bus connections
- Welcoming Culture: Mutual support, teamspirit and international collaboration; communities on numerous topics, such as coaching, agile working and business women network
- Attractive Conditions: Company car including private use collective accident insurance, home office workplace and rent subsidy
- This position is filled within the Sartorius Stedim Biotech GmbH

We promote diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from people of all nationalities, genders, sexual orientations, religions, age groups, disabilities, and cultural backgrounds.

jobs.occupation: IT Expert for the Authentication and Authorisation Infrastructure of the NFDI EOSC Node (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

IT Expert for the Authentication and Authorisation Infrastructure of the NFDI EOSC Node

Limited: 2 years | Starting date: earliest possible | ID: FHMA024/2026 | Deadline: 04.10.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The DESY group "Information Technology" (IT) is participating in a variety of high profile national and European projects, evaluating new and innovative IT technologies. We are currently participating in the build-up of the German EOSC node together with 10 other highly regarded institutions from the German research landscape and within the National Research lnfrastructure (NFDI). This effort requires a high degree of coordination between more than 300 German universities and research centers as well as national and European infrastructures. To realize this ambitious objective, we're seeking a scientist who possesses expertise in web technologies, especially in federated Authentication and Authorisation infrastructure technologies. Additionally, the ideal candidate should be driven to contribute to the development of these technologies within the evolving EOSC framework.

About your role:

- You will enable German service providers to make use of the authentication and authorisation infrastructure in the NFDI and the EOSC
- You will collect and consolidate documentation, tutorials and hands-on seminars with regard to login procedures
- You will contribute to the overall architecture and the design of the German NFDI EOSC node
- You will participate in regular project meetings, workshops and conferences, both online and in person
- You will contribute to regular reports towards the project management

About you:

- You have completed a master's degree or PhD in computer science, physics, mathematics, engineering sciences or related subjects
- You gathered experience with federated ldentity and Access Management protocols, especially SAML and OpenlD-connect
- You have good knowledge of web technologies and a modern programming language
- Familiarity with modern cloud technologies, such as Cl/CD and Kubernetes, is beneficial
- ldeally, you have worked in an academic setting before
- You are a collaborative team player who enjoys working in large, international teams and is open to travel
- You have excellent spoken and written command of the English language

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50 %). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV‑AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information, please contact Tim Wetzel at +49 40 8998-2911 (https://tel:+494089982911)  (tim.wetzel@desy.de (tim.wetzel@desy.de) ).

Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation, CV and relevant certificates).

We look forward to receiving your application via our application portal:

Apply now! (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/130669)

DESY promotes equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/130669/2/2544) . We therefore welcome applications from people of all dimensions of diversity. The professional development of women (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/130669/2/2820)  is very important to us and therefore we strongly encourage women to apply for the vacant position. Applications from severely disabled persons and those with equivalent status will be given preference if they are equally qualified (sbv.desy.de (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/130669/2/780) ).

In order to support the Supply Chain and Logistics, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student within Supply Chain and Logistics (d/f/m)

jobs.occupation: Plant PMO (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description:
About The Role:

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive professional to support in driving governance, strategic planning and the execution of plant-wide priorities. The role serves as a key coordination hub across functions, ensuring transparency, alignment and effective delivery of the Plant Master Plan, budgeting processes and strategic initiatives.

Everything we do in Electronics is to help us deliver on our purpose of being the company behind the companies, advancing digital living. We foster a global collaborative organization made up of individuals who have the passion to win, obsess about the customer, are relentlessly curious and act with urgency. You will lead the end-to-end SG&A planning, forecasting, and budgeting cycle, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with corporate guidelines. You communicate complex financial information clearly and concisely, engage and influence senior stakeholders effectively, and work confidently in a dynamic, matrixed environment.
